newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Power T$10.94 bln bond yield at 6.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Power T$10.94 bln bond yield at 6.15 pct.

text.p: State-run utility Taiwan Power Co said on Saturday it had auctioned T$10.94 billion in seven-year unsecured corporate bonds with a single yield of 6.15 percent.
The issue would be the biggest single corporate bond issue in Taiwan's history, statistics showed.

Originally, Taipower planned to raise only T$7 billion from the bonds to be issued in December. "But the market reaction was so good, and we actually have additional money demand in early next year. So we auctioned T$10.94 billion," Taipower finance director Liu Chang-ming told Reuters by telephone.
"Many market insiders said 6.15 percent is quite low," Liu said. Local newspapers estimated the rate would be lower than 6.5 percent.
The funds would be used to finance Taipower's development of power sources, Liu said.
